messages:
Ava (product): Quick sync — PRD draft uploaded for secure audit export + crypto scope. Need acceptance criteria for KMS vs HSM, retention SLAs, and rollout gating. Linking customer asks in thread.

Raj (eng-security): On it. High-level: support BYOK with HSM-backed keys, per-tenant key scopes, and signed, immutable audit bundles for long-term storage. Also: export API must require a service principal + MFA for manual exports.

Maya (compliance): For SOC2/ISO alignment we should define: retention tiers (online 1y, cold archive 6y), integrity verification (SHA256 hashes + periodic attestation), and per-region retention controls. Some enterprise customers want proof-of-non-repudiation.

Lin (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: runtime currently emits structured events for requests/errors; need to ensure we capture: model version, routing decision, latency buckets, and anonymized user identifiers (or persist plain if customer requests full trace). Edge case: partial token streams (streaming responses) — how do we record incomplete outputs? Propose we record finalization events with a `stream_final` flag.

Nora (customer-success): Two customers asked for export in Parquet + schema (timestamp, request_id, model, tokens_generated, routing, error_code). One compliance-heavy customer asked for 7-year retention in-region and an automated proof-of-deletion. They also want a retention-exception process for legal holds.

Diego (legal): BYOK/HSM brings contract and liability changes. Need CLAs and key-escrow terms. Also require clear user consent if customer chooses to persist PII in logs. Data residency commitments must be explicit in the contract.

Ava (product): Proposed acceptance criteria (short):
- Audit export: export API available for enterprise customers with RBAC + MFA; exports are signed and tamper-evident.
- KMS/HSM: support cloud KMS and customer-provided HSM (BYOK); key rotation documented and non-destructive.
- Retention: configurable per-customer, default online 1y + archive 6y; region-aware.
- Schema: provide Parquet + JSONL formats with documented schema v1.
- Proofs: periodic integrity attestations (hashes) and on-demand deletion proof.
- Rollout gates: feature-flag + private beta, security review, legal signoff, two pilot customers.

Raj (eng-security): Suggest adding: auditability of key usage (who requested wraps/unlocks), and an emergency key-rotation playbook. Also require HSM attestation logs for BYOK installs.

Lin (eng-runtime): For edge cases:
- Streaming truncation -> store finalization event with `stream_final: true` and a separate `partial_payload` pointer if exportable.
- High-throughput bursts -> exporter must support backpressure and S3-friendly multi-part bundles.
- Versioning -> exports must include runtime and model sha tags.

Maya (compliance): Add acceptance checklist items for certifications: map features to SOC2 CC6.5/ISO 27001 controls, and include retention exception workflow details (legal hold length, audit trail).

Nora (customer-success): We need clear migration notes for customers moving from Dedicated -> Private (on-prem): export tooling should work offline and with private endpoints. Also include example support playbooks for proving export integrity to customers.

Diego (legal): Also recommend a short risk paragraph in the PRD about: BYOK liability, cross-border export risk, and customer responsibilities for tenant-managed keys.

Ava (product): I'll update the PRD to incorporate these and add a short rollout plan. Quick ask: Raj and Maya — can you add 2 acceptance test cases each by EOD Friday? Lin, can you sketch the export schema and one sample Parquet layout? Nora will collect the two pilot customers.

Raj (eng-security): Will do — I'll add tests for BYOK/HSM attestation and signed export verification.

Maya (compliance): I'll add tests for retention enforcement and integrity attestation mapping to SOC2 controls.

Lin (eng-runtime): I'll drop a schema sketch here:
```json
{ "columns": [ "timestamp", "request_id", "tenant_id", "model_id", "variant", "tokens_in", "tokens_out", "latency_ms", "routing_policy", "error_code", "runtime_version" ], "notes": "PII fields redacted unless tenant opts in to full capture" }
```

deploy-bot: PRD document created: https://docs.internal/redwood/prd/secure-audit-export (Ava).

Ava (product): Thanks — will push an updated draft and tag reviewers when tests and schema are in. Short follow-up on rollout window: aim for Q3 private-beta, Q4 GA for enterprise.

Raj (eng-security): Flag: HSM BYOK installs will require ops calendar lead time — add to rollout timeline.

Maya (compliance): Noted. Also adding a training doc for SOC auditors.

Nora (customer-success): I'll confirm two pilot customers by end of week.

Ava (product): Great, thanks everyone. End of thread.
